method: Whole-file manual reading of Estonian catalog; pinned bytes reverified; structural checks retained from v91.
findings: Tõenäolised duplikaadid and Valimräsi preserve probable-versus-sampled distinction; sampling option names files over64MiB. Hash column instead says Hash / Failitee and omits prefix qualifier, unlike reviewed English label.

Recovery completion requests checking file data, possible recovery remains conditional, metadata changes request rescan, and same-source restore warns of overwriting deleted data. These are labels, not runtime recovery proof.
Stop and Suspend both translate Peata, obscuring different control semantics. Light-incidence label is Staatiline, which does not describe light source.
About body and refresh tooltips remain English; process failure and zoom tooltip suffixes are partly English. Complete key parity therefore does not mean complete translation.
Cleanup %n/%sn descriptions say tühja reaga rather than without path, potentially misleading command-template users. Tokens themselves remain intact.

Hardlink heading Kõvakettalingid may suggest hard-disk links; shadow-copy action uses generic backup wording. Sparse action remains separate from compression, regex/glob and logical/physical sizes are explicit. MSI et-EE/1061/1257 is declaration-only.
limits: No native-speaker certification, Windows rendering, keyboard or installer/runtime qualification. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
